G1_finetune_learns.rule: the W fine-tune reaches held-out P(target) >= 0.5 within 300 steps on every task; a task whose fine-tune does not learn is unscorable (the format, not the map)

P1_identity_inside.rule: the pull-back on ident32 reaches held-out P(target) >= 0.5 within 300 steps

P2_new_inside.blind_to: how the behaviour is placed; P3-P5 read that
P2_new_inside.predicted: pass (the alive (U, V) space holds ~70% of a real update by input weight; the ladder's rung-2 pull-backs learned)
P2_new_inside.rule: the pull-back on rand32 reaches held-out P(target) >= 0.5 within 300 steps

P3_pile_pgd.blind_to: the trained behaviour itself (~0 trigger positions in Pile): it says the account of the old model survived
P3_pile_pgd.positive_control: the lift of the fine-tune's delta-W
P3_pile_pgd.predicted: pass on rand1 and ident32; pass on rand32 (least sure: the update is larger than any pull-back scored so far)
P3_pile_pgd.rule: at the scored step, the pull-back's Pile PGD ratio to W0 (round 2's harness, 256 val rows, seed 0) is <= 1.5 on every task, AND the lift control's is > 1.5 on every task (metric power); stochastic ratio reported

P4_sparsity.blind_to: sparsity at the trigger (reported from the held-out windows, not scored)
P4_sparsity.positive_control: the lift of the fine-tune's delta-W
P4_sparsity.rule: at the scored step, the pull-back's Pile sparsity ratio to W0 (VPD's importance-minimality loss, p 0.4 beta 0.5, mean over 4 blocks of 64 rows) is <= 1.10, and |ratio - 1| <= 3 x the spread of its per-block ratios; the lift control reported. PROVISIONAL: no prior run of this metric exists, so the 1.10 line is a guess; the block spread is the floor

P5_retained_vs_identity.blind_to: damage outside the trigger (kl_other and the Pile ratios carry that)
P5_retained_vs_identity.positive_control: ident32 itself (a behaviour the model partly has)
P5_retained_vs_identity.predicted: FAIL: the new behaviour is kept less under Gamma's W0-style mask than the identity one (the ladder's rung 2 fell to 0.3-0.6 against 0.75-0.92 at rungs 0-1). A pass would say frozen-Gamma inside training covers a behaviour the model lacks
P5_retained_vs_identity.rule: retained_ci_masked(pull-back, rand32) >= 0.8 x retained_ci_masked(pull-back, ident32), both at their scored steps (the ladder's P2 form). Reported beside it: each pull-back against its task's do-nothing reference (pull-back - do-nothing, the re-gating floor r ~ 0.55-0.60 of the recruit test)

reported_not_scored: route split (d, r, i, e_gate, e_delta): mechanism only under reading A; e_delta = 0 by construction for the pull-back
rand1 on P5 (one bigram: the ladder's territory)
per-entry held-out P(value) at the scored step
scored_step_rule: per arm, the first checkpoint (10, 30, 100, 300) with held-out P(target) >= 0.5; else the last checkpoint, flagged 'did not learn'
